happened to me also,from the month of april,my visa was extended automatically untill july…
i haven’t received any emails or notifications..then i walked in to the ministry of interior then found out,it’s already renewed or extended but not stamp on my passport but they have it on the database..but anyways,i wanted to to be sure  so i requested to stamp on my passport just incase im going to travel out of the country..then  yes,its possible and make it one year instead..she extended my visa untill april2027
